test_cases.scenario: Guest opens the homepage and sees the 'Sign in' link
preconditions: User is not logged in (fresh browser session)
test_cases.expected_result: Homepage loads with header (logo, search bar, cart icon, 'Sign in' link), hero carousel, Featured Products grid and footer; no 'Hi, ' greeting is shown

test_cases.scenario: Logged-in customer sees 'Hi, <first name>' instead of 'Sign in'
preconditions: Customer account with first name 'Asha' exists
steps: Look at the right side of the header
test_cases.expected_result: Header shows 'Hi, Asha' and the 'Sign in' link is not displayed

test_cases.scenario: Logo returns to the homepage from another page
preconditions: User is on a page other than the homepage, e.g. /search?q=shoes
steps: Click the ShopEase logo in the header
test_cases.expected_result: Browser navigates to '/' and the homepage content is displayed

test_cases.scenario: Cart icon shows the number of items in the cart
steps: Look at the cart icon in the header
test_cases.expected_result: Cart icon shows the count 3

test_cases.scenario: Carousel rotates to the next banner every 6 seconds
preconditions: 3 active promotions exist (banners B1, B2, B3)
steps: Open '/' and note the visible banner (B1)
test_cases.expected_result: B2 becomes visible about 6 seconds after load and B3 about 12 seconds after load; no banner changes earlier than 6 seconds

test_cases.scenario: Right and left arrows move between banners
preconditions: 3 active promotions exist (banners B1, B2, B3)
test_cases.expected_result: After the right arrow B2 is shown; after the left arrow B1 is shown again

test_cases.scenario: Clicking a banner opens its promotion page
preconditions: Active promotion 'Diwali Sale' with promotion page /promo/diwali-sale
steps: Navigate the carousel to the 'Diwali Sale' banner
test_cases.expected_result: Browser navigates to /promo/diwali-sale, the configured page of that promotion

test_cases.scenario: Carousel shows at most 5 banners when 6 promotions are active
steps: Click the right arrow repeatedly, counting distinct banners until the first banner reappears or the arrow stops advancing
test_cases.expected_result: Exactly 5 distinct banners are reachable in the carousel

test_cases.scenario: Carousel shows all 5 banners when exactly 5 promotions are active
steps: Click the right arrow, counting distinct banners until the first banner reappears or the arrow stops advancing
test_cases.expected_result: All 5 promotion banners are reachable, none missing

test_cases.scenario: Carousel is hidden when there are no active promotions
preconditions: All promotions are inactive or expired
test_cases.expected_result: No carousel area, arrows or empty placeholder are displayed; the Featured Products grid follows the header directly

test_cases.scenario: Featured Products grid shows 8 complete product cards
preconditions: At least 8 in-stock products are marked as featured
test_cases.expected_result: Exactly 8 cards are shown in rows of 4; each card shows the product image, name, price and an 'Add to cart' button

test_cases.scenario: Out-of-stock featured product shows 'Out of stock' instead of 'Add to cart'
steps: Find the 'Blue Mug' card in the Featured Products grid
test_cases.expected_result: The card shows an 'Out of stock' label and no 'Add to cart' button; image, name and price are still shown

test_cases.scenario: Search with exactly 2 characters using Enter opens the results page
test_cases.expected_result: Browser navigates to /search?q=tv

test_cases.scenario: Search using the search icon opens the results page
steps: Type 'running shoes' in the search bar
test_cases.expected_result: Browser navigates to /search?q=running%20shoes (or running+shoes) and the term is preserved

test_cases.scenario: Search with 1 character is not submitted
test_cases.expected_result: The URL stays '/' and the results page is not opened after either action

test_cases.scenario: Empty search is not submitted
test_cases.expected_result: The URL stays '/' and the results page is not opened

test_cases.scenario: Footer links open About Us, Contact, Privacy Policy and Terms of Service
steps: Click each link in test data, returning to '/' after each
test_cases.expected_result: All 4 links are present and each opens the page whose title matches the link text

test_cases.scenario: Featured grid shows 2 products per row at 480px
steps: Set the browser viewport width to 480px
Scroll to the Featured Products grid
test_cases.expected_result: Products are laid out 2 per row (4 rows of 2) with no horizontal scrolling

test_cases.scenario: Featured grid shows 4 products per row at 481px
steps: Set the browser viewport width to 481px
Scroll to the Featured Products grid
test_cases.expected_result: Products are laid out 4 per row (2 rows of 4)

test_cases.scenario: Cart icon with an empty cart shows a count of 0 or no count badge
steps: Look at the cart icon in the header
test_cases.expected_result: Cart icon does not show a non-zero number (shows 0 or no badge) and no stale count from a previous session is displayed

gaps.description: Which 5 banners are shown when more than 5 promotions are active
Grid behaviour with fewer than 8 featured products

gaps.reason: Display requirement; guest and logged-in states are both covered by TC-HOME-001/002

gaps.description: No negative case for the logo link
gaps.reason: Navigation-only requirement with no failure behaviour described

gaps.description: No separate negative case for the greeting
gaps.reason: TC-HOME-001 asserts the greeting is absent for guests; TC-HOME-002 asserts 'Sign in' is absent when logged in

gaps.description: No negative case for footer links
gaps.reason: Link targets are not specified; only presence and page title are tested

coverage_summary.notes: All 9 requirements, 8 acceptance criteria and 4 business rules are covered, including the 5-banner limit, the 2-character search minimum and the 480px breakpoint. Search rejection behaviour (TC-HOME-015/016) is based on assumption A-1. Remaining risks are banner selection with more than 5 promotions and a partially filled featured grid.

requirements.text: Homepage is served at '/' for guests and logged-in customers
Header shows the ShopEase logo, which always returns to the homepage
Header cart icon shows the number of items in the cart
Header shows 'Sign in' for guests and 'Hi, <first name>' for logged-in customers
Hero banner carousel shows promotional banners
Featured Products grid shows product cards
Search bar opens the results page
Footer contains About Us, Contact, Privacy Policy and Terms of Service links
Page is usable on mobile (<= 480px wide)

acceptance_criteria.text: Each banner links to its promotion page
Each product card shows image, name, price and an 'Add to cart' button
Out-of-stock products show an 'Out of stock' label instead of the 'Add to cart' button
At <= 480px the featured grid shows 2 products per row; otherwise 4 per row

business_rules.text: The carousel shows at most 5 banners
If there are no active promotions the carousel is hidden
The Featured Products grid shows 8 products
